algebra-distributive-partial.label: Distributed to the first term only
algebra-distributive-partial.watchFor: Draw the area model — the outside factor touches BOTH terms.

coord-xy-swapped.label: Swapped the x and y coordinates
coord-xy-swapped.labelEs: Intercambió las coordenadas x e y
coord-xy-swapped.watchFor: Have them trace the horizontal move with a finger before the vertical one.

decimal-place-value.label: Right digits, wrong magnitude
decimal-place-value.watchFor: Estimate to the nearest whole first, then count decimal places out loud.

division-quotient-missing-zero.label: Dropped a placeholder zero in the quotient
division-quotient-missing-zero.labelEs: Omitió un cero de posición en el cociente
division-quotient-missing-zero.watchFor: Estimate first — 4,896 ÷ 12 is about 400, not 40 — then check the quotient has a digit above every digit that was brought down.

equation-answered-with-given-number.label: Answered with a number already in the equation
equation-answered-with-given-number.labelEs: Respondió con un número que ya estaba en la ecuación
equation-answered-with-given-number.watchFor: Ask them to substitute their answer back into the original equation out loud.

equation-not-inverse-operation.label: Did not undo the operation
equation-not-inverse-operation.watchFor: Have them name the operation acting on the variable BEFORE they touch both sides.

exponent-as-multiplication.label: Multiplied the base by the exponent
exponent-as-multiplication.labelEs: Multiplicó la base por el exponente
exponent-as-multiplication.watchFor: Expand it once — write out every factor before evaluating.

factorization-stopped-early.label: Stopped factoring before every factor was prime
factorization-stopped-early.labelEs: Dejó de factorizar antes de que todos los factores fueran primos
factorization-stopped-early.watchFor: Point at each factor and ask: can this one still be broken apart?

factors-multiples-confused.label: Confused factors with multiples
factors-multiples-confused.watchFor: Ask which number divides which — factors go INTO it, multiples come OUT of it.

fraction-added-denominators.label: Added the denominators
fraction-added-denominators.watchFor: Return to a bar model — thirds plus fifths cannot become eighths.

fraction-no-reciprocal.label: Divided fractions without inverting
fraction-no-reciprocal.watchFor: Ask them to check with a whole-number case they already trust.

fraction-straight-across-division.label: Divided numerators and denominators straight across
fraction-straight-across-division.watchFor: Reground division as “how many of these fit into that?”

geom-surface-area-as-volume.label: Found the volume instead of the surface area
geom-surface-area-as-volume.labelEs: Halló el volumen en vez del área total
geom-surface-area-as-volume.watchFor: Ask what the unit has to be — square units cover a surface, cubic units fill a space.

geom-triangle-area-no-half.label: Found base × height but forgot the half
geom-triangle-area-no-half.labelEs: Calculó base × altura pero olvidó la mitad
geom-triangle-area-no-half.watchFor: Draw the rectangle around the triangle — the triangle is half of it.

geom-volume-added-dimensions.label: Added the dimensions instead of multiplying
geom-volume-added-dimensions.labelEs: Sumó las dimensiones en vez de multiplicarlas
geom-volume-added-dimensions.watchFor: Build one layer of unit cubes first, then count the layers.

inequality-boundary-inclusion.label: Boundary value wrongly included or excluded
inequality-boundary-inclusion.labelEs: Valor límite incluido o excluido por error
inequality-boundary-inclusion.watchFor: Have them test the boundary value itself — does it make the statement true?

inequality-direction-flipped.label: Right boundary, symbol reversed
inequality-direction-flipped.watchFor: Ask which moves can flip a symbol — adding and subtracting never do.

inequality-graph-direction.label: Graph shaded toward the wrong side
inequality-graph-direction.labelEs: Gráfica sombreada hacia el lado equivocado
inequality-graph-direction.watchFor: Make them test one number from the shaded side out loud before accepting a graph.

measure-area-perimeter-swap.label: Swapped area and perimeter
measure-area-perimeter-swap.watchFor: Ask what the unit should be — units or square units?

op-added-instead-of-multiplied.label: Added when the problem multiplies
op-added-instead-of-multiplied.watchFor: Ask what the operation *does* to the quantity before they compute.

op-divided-instead-of-multiplied.label: Divided when the problem multiplies
op-divided-instead-of-multiplied.watchFor: Estimate first — should the answer be bigger or smaller than you started?

op-multiplied-instead-of-added.label: Multiplied when the problem adds
op-multiplied-instead-of-added.watchFor: Have them restate the problem as a story, then name the operation.

op-multiplied-instead-of-divided.label: Multiplied when the problem divides
op-multiplied-instead-of-divided.watchFor: Estimate first — should the answer be bigger or smaller than you started?

op-reversed-division.label: Divided in the wrong order
op-reversed-division.watchFor: Ask “what is being split, and into how many?” before they write it.

op-reversed-subtraction.label: Subtracted in the wrong order
op-reversed-subtraction.watchFor: Anchor both numbers on a number line before subtracting.

order-of-operations-left-to-right.label: Worked left to right instead of by operation order
order-of-operations-left-to-right.labelEs: Trabajó de izquierda a derecha en vez de por orden de operaciones
order-of-operations-left-to-right.watchFor: Have them circle the operation that must go first, then compute.

percent-scale-off-by-100.label: Percent answer off by a factor of 100
percent-scale-off-by-100.labelEs: Respuesta de porcentaje errada por un factor de 100
percent-scale-off-by-100.watchFor: Benchmark against 50% and 10% before trusting the number.

percent-used-as-whole-number.label: Used the percent as a plain number
percent-used-as-whole-number.labelEs: Usó el porcentaje como número entero
percent-used-as-whole-number.watchFor: Make them say the percent as “per hundred” out loud.

property-order-vs-grouping.label: Confused the commutative and associative properties
property-order-vs-grouping.labelEs: Confundió la propiedad conmutativa con la asociativa
property-order-vs-grouping.watchFor: Ask what actually MOVED: the order of the numbers, or the parentheses?

rate-not-per-one.label: Gave the total instead of the unit rate
rate-not-per-one.labelEs: Dio el total en vez de la tasa unitaria
rate-not-per-one.watchFor: Ask “per ONE what?” and make them finish the sentence.

ratio-as-difference.label: Combined the two amounts instead of comparing them
ratio-as-difference.labelEs: Combinó las dos cantidades en vez de compararlas
ratio-as-difference.watchFor: Have them say the comparison out loud — “for every ___ there are ___” — before writing anything.

ratio-compared-without-common-basis.label: Compared two ratios without a common basis
ratio-compared-without-common-basis.labelEs: Comparó dos razones sin una base común
ratio-compared-without-common-basis.watchFor: Ask what ONE of each is worth before either ratio is compared.

ratio-inverted.label: Flipped the ratio
ratio-inverted.watchFor: Have them label both quantities with units before writing the ratio.

ratio-scaled-additively.label: Scaled a ratio by adding instead of multiplying
ratio-scaled-additively.labelEs: Escaló una razón sumando en vez de multiplicando
ratio-scaled-additively.watchFor: Ask what ONE batch is worth, then how many batches — a ratio grows by copies, not by steps.

sign-dropped.label: Right magnitude, lost the negative sign
sign-dropped.labelEs: Magnitud correcta, perdió el signo negativo
sign-dropped.watchFor: Place the answer on a number line — which side of zero?

stat-center-vs-spread.label: Confused a measure of center with a measure of spread
stat-center-vs-spread.labelEs: Confundió una medida de centro con una de dispersión
stat-center-vs-spread.watchFor: Ask what the question wants to know: a typical value, or how scattered the data is?

stat-frequency-vs-value.label: Reported a data value where a frequency was asked
stat-frequency-vs-value.labelEs: Dio un valor de los datos donde se pedía una frecuencia
stat-frequency-vs-value.watchFor: Ask them to point at the axis their number came from before they answer.

stat-histogram-bin-misread.label: Misread the bins or the scale on a data display
stat-histogram-bin-misread.labelEs: Leyó mal los intervalos o la escala de una gráfica
stat-histogram-bin-misread.watchFor: Have them point to the interval's two endpoints and say which values belong inside it.

stat-mean-skewed-by-outlier.label: Chose the mean when an outlier distorts it
stat-mean-skewed-by-outlier.labelEs: Eligió la media cuando un valor atípico la distorsiona
stat-mean-skewed-by-outlier.watchFor: Have them cover the outlier and recompute — how far does the mean move?

stat-mean-vs-median.label: Used the mean where the median was asked (or the reverse)
stat-mean-vs-median.labelEs: Usó la media donde se pedía la mediana (o al revés)
stat-mean-vs-median.watchFor: Ask them to say which word the question used, then what that word tells you to DO with the numbers.

stat-question-no-variability.label: Chose a question with only one fixed answer
stat-question-no-variability.labelEs: Escogió una pregunta con una sola respuesta fija
stat-question-no-variability.watchFor: Ask: would two different people give two different answers?

stat-range-for-iqr.label: Used the full range instead of the IQR
stat-range-for-iqr.labelEs: Usó el rango completo en vez del rango intercuartílico
stat-range-for-iqr.watchFor: Have them mark Q1 and Q3 on the plot and cover everything outside them.

stat-summed-instead-of-averaged.label: Added the data set instead of averaging it
stat-summed-instead-of-averaged.labelEs: Sumó el conjunto de datos en vez de promediarlo
stat-summed-instead-of-averaged.watchFor: Ask whether the answer could be a realistic single value in that set.
